conclusion: Bundled web pages translate through resources/web/include/i18n.js, data-i18n keys, and the host gettext dictionary ORCA_UI_STRINGS. Missing legacy text.js references or redundant declarations can abort initialization before RequestProfile. Printer pages 21 and 24 load guide/21/common.js and initialize its globals once; material pages 22 and 23 use guide/22/common.js without overriding its selection functions. Selection submits full preset names from filalist through save_userguide_filaments. Simplified and Traditional Chinese catalogs must cover the host keys used by static markup and dynamic controls.
scope: InlongSlicer bundled web wizard and preset dialogs

verification.summary: Reviewed active script imports and inline declarations against the shared implementations. Headless Edge passed 34 scenarios using compiled Chinese catalogs and repository vendor fixtures: 10 printer models, 18 INLONG materials and 14 Infinity3DP materials; rendering, default selection, filtered selection, complete preset-name submission and Escape handling passed. Eight web/profile regression tests passed. Native profile validation passed for both vendors. Runtime receipts are supplemental; the listed source snapshots support the durable conclusion.
